proposals.evidence: Turner grāma explicitly gives Nepali gāũ, western Pahari grā̃/graũ, Gujarati gām and Marathi gāv village. These survey forms fit the corresponding regional village stems and inflectional vowels. Anomalous gʰoṛā̃ and velar-final gaŋ are excluded rather than assumed to have regular outcomes.
